latest_events.title: Niger: A terrorist logistics base dismantled near Torodi

latest_events.title: Mali: Mauritania, the Maghreb country most exposed to the crisis, according to the IEEE
latest_events.summary: On 13 November 2023, the Spanish Institute for Strategic Studies (IEEE) published an analysis identifying Mauritania as the Maghreb country most directly threatened by the deteriorating situation in Mali. Authored by analyst Jaime Bello, the text specifies that his views do not represent the position of the Spanish Ministry of Defence. According to him, Nouakchott is under three pressures at once: a porous border, the terrorist threat and the mass influx of refugees.

A Burkinabé columnist for RFI and former ministers of ex-President Blaise Compaoré are among those targeted.
latest_events.summary: On Friday, 13 November, the authorities of Burkina Faso announced that they had issued arrest warrants for around twenty people in exile, including journalists, activists, a former minister and former officers, for alleged acts of "terrorism". . latest_events.title: Burkina Faso’s rival armed groups turn on each other as state loses ground
latest_events.summary: Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso – Armed fighters from two rival groups have fought a series of increasingly deadly battles along Burkina Faso’s northern border with Mali, as the government struggles to reassert control over large parts of the country. The clashes between Jama’at Nusrat al-Islam wal Muslimin (JNIM), an al-Qaeda affiliate, and the ISIL affiliate in Sahel Province (ISSP) have intensified since early September, with both groups competing for territory and influence across the borderlands.

The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out several precision strikes on 10 and 11 November 2026 against identified targets in the Kidal, Timbuktu and Sikasso regions.

latest_events.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The Malian Army neutralises several terrorist targets in Tinzaouatène, Tonka and Sikasso
latest_events.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, approximately twenty-seven (27) kilometres north-west of Tinzaouatène, in the Kidal region, a previously identified terrorist target was struck three (03) times.

latest_events.title: Gao-N 'tahaka axis: the FAMa neutralize armed men who racketeered travelers
latest_events.summary: Gao-N 'tahaka axis: the FAMa neutralize armed men who racketeered travellers The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) put an end to the actions of armed men who set up illegal roadblocks on the Gao-N'tahaka axis to extort money from travellers. This operation should make it possible to strengthen security on this strategic route, heavily used by carriers and the populations of the region .
